name: task-orchestration
description: Runs the full implement-and-commit loop over a task list — selects the next incomplete sub-task, implements it, runs linters and tests, marks it done, commits, and repeats until the list is finished. Use when asked to work through a feature's task list at .ai/[feature]/tasks.md unattended, or to keep going until every sub-task is complete. For a single sub-task with no commit, use task-implementation; to stop for approval between each one, use iterative-development.
